task.title: Reject unsafe whitespace-bearing gateway URLs
task.objective: Fail closed on configured or returned gateway URLs containing whitespace, controls, backslashes, or credentials
acceptance_criteria: ASCII and Unicode separator whitespace are rejected
Controls, backslashes, and embedded credentials are rejected through the same URL boundary
Invalid configured origins fail before token lookup and invalid stream URLs fail before transcript mutation or transport

attempts.summary: Added configured-origin and returned-stream URL regressions including Unicode whitespace
attempts.diagnostic: The focused test accepted a stream path containing an ASCII space

attempts.summary: Introduced one shared forbidden-character predicate for base origins and returned stream URLs

outcome.summary: Gateway URL validation now rejects ambiguous whitespace and unsafe syntax before credentials, transport, or composer changes

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1098

lessons: Apply the same URL safety predicate to configured origins and server-returned locations
Unicode separator categories must be considered alongside visible ASCII whitespace
